instruction: Complete the task using the batch-capable scripting and fabrication-output interfaces of Altium Designer 17.0.6. The native four-layer PCB `demo.PcbDoc`, `demo.pcb.json`, `nc_param.json`, and `components.json` are on the desktop. Generate NC drill output. Requirements: - Write the required deliverables into `C:\Users\user\Desktop\result`. - `demo.drl` must contain the unmodified bytes of Altium Designer 17's native ASCII Excellon NC Drill output (normally generated as `demo.TXT`) in the units requested by `nc_param.json`, identify the holes as plated, and use every via and its referenced padstack hole as drill hits/tools. - `ncdrill.log` must be the unedited native Altium drill report. It may identify the generated drill file by its native name `demo.TXT`; submit that report under the required name `ncdrill.log`. The report must confirm a Top Layer to Bottom Layer through span, PTH output, the actual tool sizes, and the hole count. - Treat board component x/y locations as points when checking circular keepouts. `collision_report.json` must contain `checked_components`, source-ordered `collisions` entries with `component` and `keepout`, and `status` equal to `clear` or `collision`. [Software] Before starting the work, the available entry points are OrCAD Capture at `C:\Cadence\SPB_24.1\tools\bin\Capture.exe`, Altium Designer at `C:\Program Files (x86)\Altium\AD17\DXP.EXE`, and OpenSCAD at `C:\Program Files\OpenSCAD\openscad.exe`.
